#+title: habshe-emacs — package manifest
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Installation only, per the rules: this module owns the manifest of
external packages and the ensure-pass that installs them. It never
configures anything — each package's configuration lives in its own
=my-<package>= module, loaded after this one.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-packages.el"
  ;;; my-packages.el --- GENERATED from org/packages.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: Owns the external-package manifest and the ensure
  ;;; pass that installs anything missing at startup. Never configures.

  (defgroup my-packages nil
    "External package installation for my Emacs configuration.")

  (defcustom my-packages-manifest '(yasnippet whole-line-or-region)
    "External packages to install at startup.
Each entry is a symbol accepted by `package-install'. Packages
not on any archive are installed separately via
`package-vc-install' and do not belong in this list."
    :group 'my-packages
    :type '(repeat symbol))

  (defvar my-packages--archives-refreshed nil
    "Whether package archives have been refreshed this session.")

  (defun my-packages--refresh-archives ()
    "Refresh package archive contents, once per session."
    (unless my-packages--archives-refreshed
      (package-refresh-contents)
      (setq my-packages--archives-refreshed t)))

  (defun my-packages-ensure-installed ()
    "Install every manifest package that is missing.
Archives are refreshed once, and only if something is missing."
    (let ((missing (seq-remove #'package-installed-p my-packages-manifest)))
      (when missing
        (my-packages--refresh-archives)
        (dolist (package missing)
          (package-install package)))))

  (my-packages-ensure-installed)
  (provide 'my-packages)
#+end_src
